gates.notes: Template validates locally, but final go/no-go remains pending until release owner signoff.

gates.notes: Manual real-device QA artifact is structured but non-final. Windows Chrome, macOS Safari, Android Chrome, iOS Safari, Chromecast, AirPlay/Apple TV, and PWA install/offline evidence remain pending.

gates.notes: Template/test coverage exists, but final rendered design parity evidence is not signed off for beta.

gates.name: V1 provider/XUI owner capacity and no-media-processing signoff
gates.notes: Partial provider owner artifact validates non-final. Provider/XUI owner identity, capacity approval, rate-limit/escalation path, and explicit no XUI-side transcode/remux/generated-HLS commitment remain pending.

gates.notes: Partial artifact validates non-final. no-media-processing-verification passes with manual audit evidence plus the release no-media evidence scanner; provider owner, Lumen edge capacity, observability SLO, rollback/throttle plan, and final signoff remain pending.

gates.name: V1 runtime no-transcode/no-remux media policy
gates.notes: Partial artifact validates non-final. Web gateway, proxy default no-remux, committed env, local process, and no-media evidence scanner checks pass; provider/XUI no-transcode owner confirmation remains pending.

gates.name: V1 production observability baseline
gates.notes: Concrete observability baseline artifact validates source event coverage, alert threshold rules, and no-media stop-trigger evidence. Beta launch alert routing, owner response, dashboard, and SLO signoff remain pending.

gates.name: V1 beta observability and rollback/throttle signoff
gates.notes: Partial ops signoff artifact validates non-final. Observability owner, alert channel, dashboard, SLO thresholds, rollback/throttle owner, notification route, decision authority, and final approval remain pending.

gates.name: V1 security/privacy baseline review
gates.notes: Concrete security/privacy baseline validates storage inventory source refs, credential cleanup evidence, retention evidence, and secret hygiene coverage. Incident owner/runbook/channel and final security/privacy signoff remain pending.

items.summary: Final go/no-go checklist and release-owner approval are not complete.
items.disposition: Complete the final go/no-go checklist only after every concrete gate is non-pending, every blocker is closed or mitigated, rollback ownership is assigned, and release-owner approval is recorded.

items.summary: Desktop/mobile/Cast/AirPlay/PWA compatibility and manual target evidence is incomplete.
items.disposition: Run real target evidence or approved device-lab evidence before final beta signoff; Playwright/headless evidence is not enough for real-device approval.

items.summary: Provider/XUI owner capacity approval for 300-500 beta users is missing.
items.disposition: Needs external owner confirmation in artifacts/release/provider/qaf035-provider-owner-signoff-20260603.json that the beta account/upstream service can support the cohort without XUI-side transcode/remux.

items.summary: Provider/XUI owner identity, rate-limit/escalation contact, and no-media-processing commitment are missing.
items.disposition: Record the provider/XUI owner, upstream account scope, escalation path, and explicit commitment that broken catch-up will not be solved with XUI-side transcode/remux/generated HLS or other server-side media processing.

items.summary: Approved release-run startup and RSS performance numbers are missing.
items.disposition: Record numeric startup p95/p99, RSS peak/p95, failed-run accounting, approved environment details, and release-owner performance signoff in the performance artifact.

items.summary: Runtime no-transcode/no-remux provider/XUI owner confirmation is missing.
items.disposition: Finalize runtime media policy only after owner-backed evidence confirms provider-direct/proxy-normalized playback remains the beta/prod path and no local ffmpeg, server-side transcode/remux, generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, remux-hls, or XUI-side media processing is allowed.

items.summary: Beta alert routing, dashboard, response SLO, and observability owner are missing.
items.disposition: Assign beta alert owner/channel/dashboard/response SLO and record evidence that playback, cast, startup-timeout, and no-media stop triggers route to a real launch responder.

items.summary: Observability SLO and rollback/throttle owners are not signed off.
items.disposition: Assign launch owners and record alert route, rollback/throttle decision path, and max decision time evidence.

items.summary: Security/privacy incident owner, runbook, response channel, and final signoff are missing.
items.disposition: Finalize the security/privacy baseline only after the incident runbook, named owner, response channel, notification SLA, and release-owner approval are recorded.

triggers: Any release-blocker regression in playback, cast handoff, or data integrity.
Provider overload, 429/5xx escalation, or startup/failure SLO breach during beta enrollment.
Any evidence of catch-up playback using local ffmpeg, server-side transcode/remux, generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, remux-hls, or XUI-side media processing.
steps: Stop beta enrollment and switch release recommendation to no-go.
Keep catch-up failures on provider-direct/proxy-normalized playback or unsupported overlay; do not enable transcode/remux workaround.
Re-deploy last known good build or roll back the PR if web regressions are introduced.
Re-run provider preflight, compatibility matrix slices, capacity artifact validation, and no-media-processing audit before resuming enrollment.
verificationChecks: Manual browser/network audit and no-media evidence scanner remain free of __remux__, remux, remux-hls, ffmpeg, ffprobe, transcode, proxy-remuxed, generated-HLS, and XUI-side media-processing hits.
Compatibility matrix has no release-blocker failures and pending target evidence is explicitly triaged.
Beta capacity artifact validates and final signoff remains blocked until owner evidence is complete.
rollback.notes: Partial rollback plan only. Final beta readiness still needs named owner and notification channel.

signoff.notes: Partial readiness rollup only. This artifact must fail --require-final until all gates are non-pending, blocker triage is closed/mitigated, rollback owner/channel are set, and final signoff is approved.
